entities.name: Henge of Ramos
entities.description: Impact crater of Ramos on Mercadia where the Bones of Ramos were found.

entities.name: Ramos
entities.description: Dragon engine buried in the crater who erected an altar of powerstones.

entities.name: Bones of Ramos
entities.description: Set of powerstones each tapping a distinct color of mana.

entities.name: Deepwood
entities.description: Home of the dryads protecting the shrine.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Ship whose crew reached the Henge.

entities.name: Weatherlight crew
entities.description: Surviving seven crew members who reached the Henge.

entities.name: Power Matrix
entities.description: Device the powerstones were to charge.

events.summary: The surviving seven Weatherlight crew reach the Henge of Ramos after the vine dryad attack.
events.quote: the surviving seven members of the Weatherlight crew

events.summary: Ramos stirs awake, disparages them, then lets the crew take five powerstones to charge the Power Matrix, warning the charge will fade away from him.
events.quote: Ramos himself stirred awake when they arrived at the shrine

relations.note: He erected the altar with them.
relations.quote: erected an altar with the Bones of Ramos
